summary.zh-CN: 多头注意力把同一输入分别投影到多组较小的 [[term:qkv-projection|Query、Key、Value]] 子空间，每一头独立计算注意力，再把各头结果拼接并做输出投影。不同头因此可以学习不同位置关系或特征关系。
summary.en-US: Multi-head attention projects the same input into several smaller [[term:qkv-projection|Query, Key, and Value]] subspaces, computes attention independently in each head, then concatenates the results and applies an output projection. Different heads can learn different positional or feature relationships.

coreConclusion.zh-CN: 多头不是重复同一份注意力，而是用多组独立投影并行学习多种读取关系，最后统一融合。
coreConclusion.en-US: Multi-head attention is not the same attention repeated. It uses several independent projections to learn multiple reading relationships in parallel and fuses them at the end.
